parrafo_1.es: Bill Riley Painting es un negocio local de St. Petersburg, FL. El que responde el mensaje es el mismo que llega a hacer el trabajo: sin centrales telefónicas ni intermediarios.
parrafo_1.en: Bill Riley Painting is a local St. Petersburg, FL business. Whoever answers your message is who shows up to do the work: no call centers, no middlemen.

parrafo_2.es: Una reseña reciente de Emily Fasnacht lo resume bien: "Hicieron el trabajo duro de preparar el exterior de la casa antes de pintarla", incluyendo reparación de madera podrida y trabajo de estuco que otros contratistas habían dejado pendiente.
parrafo_2.en: A recent review from Emily Fasnacht sums it up: "They did the hard work of prepping the exterior of the house before it was painted," including rotten wood replacement and stucco work that previous contractors had skipped.

items.quote: Bill Riley and his team did a fantastic job painting my home's exterior. They repaired some rotted wood and did a couple other extras for a fair price. Everyone was very personable and easy to work with. I would not hesitate to use them again.
We had an excellent experience with Bill and his team. They did the hard work of prepping the exterior of the house before it was painted.
